Location

Eastern Zao Steppe, in his palace.

Notes

He is a lizard priest who needs help to fight against the dragonkin wreaking havoc behind the mountains, on the so-called Muggy Plains. He claims to receive visions from his deity The Great Snake. Part of the Children of the Revolution Quest and the Wrath of the Emperor Quest. At the end of the Wrath of the Emperor Quest, you will kill him and thereby make his small room on the Zao Steppe inaccessible.
